title: Settings
description: Organization, design, email, storage, AI, PDF and module settings.

form.savedSecretsCleared: Settings saved. Because the target changed, the following was discarded – please enter it again: {labels}
form.contrastLow: – just below the minimum of 4.5 : 1. Choose a lighter or darker color.
form.noPermission: You don’t have permission to change these settings.

testMail.title: Test email
testMail.description: Save your changes first, then send a test message.
testMail.subject: Test email
testMail.text:
Hello,

this message confirms that email delivery is configured correctly. This is what an email with your organization’s layout looks like.
testMail.failed: Email delivery failed. Please check host, port, TLS and credentials; details are in the server log.

general.systemDescription: Name of the system plus name, address and contact of your organization (e.g. for letters and PDF documents).
general.missingLegal: No link yet: {links}. The sign-in page and public pages only show links that have been entered in the footer.
general.retentionDescription: Logs with IP addresses are only kept as long as set here. The daily job “core.housekeeping” deletes older entries or removes the IP addresses. Your organization sets the periods (record of processing activities).

mail.title: SMTP server
mail.description: The system sends all emails through this server. The password is stored encrypted and never sent to the browser.

ai.intro: AI service (OpenAI): central configuration and usage of all modules.
ai.privacyTitle: Privacy: data is sent to an external service
ai.privacyText1: Everything modules send to the AI goes to the configured provider (base URL) – possibly outside the EU. Before turning it on, you need a data processing agreement (DPA) with the provider; for third countries also a legal basis for the transfer.
ai.privacyText2: Don’t send health data, data about children or contact details; replace names with placeholders where possible. Only counters (requests, tokens, costs) are stored here, no content.
ai.usageDescription: Costs are estimates based on the configured prices.
ai.tableEmpty: The AI service hasn’t been used this month yet.
ai.configDescription: The API key is stored encrypted and never sent to the browser.
ai.assistDescription: Suggestions for texts in messages, actions, events, the website and other modules. Who may use it is controlled by each module’s “AI writing assistant” permission (roles).
ai.assistPrivacy: The writing assistant sends the text in the field and key facts (e.g. date, place and fee of an action) to the provider, never recipient lists, participants or health data. Email addresses, phone numbers and IBANs are masked first. Please add a paragraph about the writing assistant to your privacy policy.

design.appearanceDescription: Accent color and background of the app icons.
design.logoDescription: Appears in PDF documents, in the sidebar, on the sign-in page, as the favicon in the browser tab and as the app icon (home screen, push notifications). Without a logo, the default icons are used.
design.needStorage: To upload a logo, you also need write access to storage.
design.dialogDescription: PNG, JPEG or WebP. After choosing a file you select the crop; square works best for favicon and app icon.
design.removeDescription: PDFs appear without a logo; favicon and app icon show the default icons again.

modules.emptyDescription: None of the enabled modules has its own settings. You enable modules under Administration → Modules.
modules.ownPage: This module has its own settings page.
modules.ownPageNoAccess: This module has its own settings page. You don’t have permission for it.

notifications.pushDescription: Notifications directly on the phone or computer (Web Push). Everyone chooses in their profile under “Notifications” what they get by email, push or both. Without push, everything comes by email.
notifications.keysDescription: Generated automatically; the private key is stored encrypted. Only regenerate it if it may have fallen into the wrong hands – afterwards everyone has to re-enable push on their devices.
notifications.rotateDescription: {count, plural, one {The # registered device loses its} other {All # registered devices lose their}} push subscription and must re-enable push in the profile.
notifications.rotated: New keys generated – {count, plural, one {# device needs} other {# devices need}} to re-enable push

storage.title: S3 storage
storage.description: Connection to AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO or other S3-compatible services. Credentials are stored encrypted and never sent to the browser.
